summary: A 1935 Aermotor tower in Lost River State Park, WV; its lower stairs have been removed, and a parks foundation campaign aims to restore it for visitors.

facts.design: Aermotor 7x7 ft cab on an 80 ft tower
facts.agency: West Virginia Division of Natural Resources

access.note: Inside Lost River State Park and reached on foot. A parks foundation campaign aims to make the tower available to park visitors, which suggests it is not open to them now.

visit.trail_note: Hike from a gravel lot just across the state line on U.S. Route 33 (travel blog gives 2.6 miles round trip). A 2021 register visit comment says 4 miles.

events.note: Erected by the West Virginia Division of Forestry as an Aermotor 7x7 tower on an 80 ft structure
Registered December 7, 2010 as US 893, WV 8; nominated by Robert Beanblossom
Visit report dated September 12, 2021: lower two flights of stairs removed; tower would take work to get back in shape

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 2021 register visit comment says a 4 mile hike. A travel blog gives 2.6 miles round trip from a gravel lot on U.S. Route 33. The story reports both and does not pick one.

The register credits the WV Division of Forestry with erecting the tower in 1935. The parks foundation calls it a CCC-era tower. Both can be true, but no source found names a CCC crew. The story reports the foundation's wording as its own.

notes_for_editor: Construction date and design are well supported by the register and a local site. Current condition rests on the 2021 register visit; no 2025-2026 report was found. Staffing history not found; the register's staffed field is blank. Hike length conflicts (2.6 vs 4 miles). A YouTube search snippet describes the tower as 60 ft (Aermotor MC-39); the fetched page had no description text, so this is not used. The Lost River State Park Wikipedia page does not mention the tower. No photos added; licenses not checked. Read budget ran about two pages over the cap.
